description: A PHP class extending SugarView to handle resetting modules in SuiteCRM, including removing custom fields, layouts, relationships, labels, and extensions. It manages user interface elements, handles save requests, and performs cleanup actions for module customization data.

classes.name: ViewResetmodule
classes.description: A SugarCRM SuiteCRM class for resetting modules, including removing custom fields, layouts, relationships, labels, and extensions, with methods handling various cleanup operations.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module's title bar, including translated module names.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the reset module interface, including breadcrumbs and actions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes reset actions based on user input, performing cleanup and updating UI.

methods.name: removeCustomFields
methods.description: Removes custom fields defined in studio for the current module.

methods.name: removeCustomLayouts
methods.description: Removes custom layout metadata files for the current module.

methods.name: removeCustomRelationships
methods.description: Removes all relationships that are custom or from studio for the current module.

methods.name: removeCustomLabels
methods.description: Deletes language files for the current module to remove custom labels.

methods.name: removeCustomExtensions
methods.description: Removes custom extension directories and rebuilds extensions for the current module.
